findings.evidence: and for a moment the boat was only a boat on the water, and fifty years of Tom Vane were floating in front of the men who had known him
findings.diagnosis: Two offenses: 'the boat was only a boat' is the sententious X-is-only-X construction, and 'fifty years of Tom Vane were floating' names the freight as abstraction. The float already does the work; the gloss deflates it.

findings.evidence: Rennie read the boat the way she had read the plank.
findings.diagnosis: The explicit 'the way she had...' manner-comparison is the profile's flagged tic; cut to the perception itself.

findings.evidence: the Kittiwake went down stern-first into her own reflection
findings.diagnosis: 'into her own reflection' is a pretty flourish that doesn't alter perception; against plainspoken.
